title: Kicked Molten Jamaican Collard Stew
description: A tangy and flavorful stew featuring collard greens, inspired by Jamaican cuisine, with a rich and molten texture, made in a Dutch oven. This dish is low-glycemic-friendly and perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped collard greens and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
